title: Trait Inheritance
guideIdle: 1) Pick a trait · 2) Set Mother & Father genotypes · 3) Tap Cross to fill the grid
guideFilling: Crossing… watch each offspring box fill with a genotype and colored phenotype.
guideDone: Cross complete! Compare genotypes and phenotypes across all 4 boxes below.
guideQuiz: Quick check unlocked — answer it to earn a star!
learnMore: A Punnett square lists every possible allele combination from two parents — the 2×2 grid predicts genotype and phenotype ratios in their offspring.
tapAlleleHint: Tap a letter on the grid edge to flip that allele
probabilitiesNone: Tap Cross to reveal offspring probabilities.
